releaseNotes:
What changed:
- The short drama swipe now moves the picture with your finger, with the next drama's
  cover following straight behind it.
- Short dramas fill the phone screen instead of sitting between black bands. The
  Picture control still cycles if you want them fitted.
- Swiping onto a drama you have already started picks up at your last episode rather
  than starting it again, and says so before it opens.
- A drama reached by a swipe keeps its cover on screen while the stream opens, instead
  of cutting to the loading page.

Already on 1.53.0 or newer? This installs itself as usual.

On 1.52.1 or older? 1.53.0 changed the app's identity, so Android will not install this
over your copy and the in-app update stops with "The downloaded update belongs to a
different app." Uninstall GIZTV once, then install this build from the release page.
Watch history does not carry across that one reinstall. Updates after it are automatic.
